caseName: New Orleans Chapter, Associated General Contractors of America, Inc. v. United States

attorneys: R. Emmett Kerrigan, Ralph L. Kaskell, Jr., and George W. Wise for appellant., Solicitor General Griswold, Assistant Attorney General McLaren, and Irwin A. Seibel for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.
